item.title: Beyblade X 'True Future' Arc Drops April 17: Double Episode Premiere Details
item.description: The Beyblade X anime officially launches its “True Future Arc” on Friday, April 17, 2026, kicking off with a double-episode premiere (Episodes 123 and 124) streaming at 7:00 PM JST on the official BEYBEY TUBE YouTube channel.

item.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Gameplay, Release Window, and Roster Details
item.description: Vampire hunting is back on the schedule. Konami finally handed the keys to their most neglected property over to Evil Empire and Motion Twin, the exact development duo who made the Return to Castlevania DLC so fantastic it practically demanded a standalone title.

item.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 1 Closes Historic 266-Day Theatrical Run
item.description: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai officially closed its primary Japanese box office run on April 9, 2026.

item.title: Nintendo Launches Free 'Hello, Yoshi!' App for Kids: Everything Parents Need to Know
item.description: Nintendo officially released the free Hello, Yoshi! app on April 9 across the Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android platforms.

item.title: Eden of the East Stage Play Adaptation Confirmed for Tokyo in 2027: Dates, Creator Quotes, and Franchise History
item.description: Seventeen years after its original television debut, the psychological thriller anime Eden of the East is officially getting a live-action stage adaptation.

item.title: The Level 999 Villager Anime Casts Yuichiro Umehara as Menou: Release Date, Plot, and Cast Details
item.description: The upcoming Summer 2026 fantasy anime The Level 999 Villager has officially cast veteran voice actor Yuichiro Umehara to play Menou, a high-ranking demon noble.

item.title: Yoshihiro Togashi Finishes Hunter x Hunter Chapter 430, Drops Sailor Moon Crossover Art
item.description: Yoshihiro Togashi has officially finished inking Hunter x Hunter Chapter 430.

item.title: Netflix’s 'The One Piece' Remake Reveals First Concept Art and Wit Studio Staff
item.description: Netflix just dropped the first visual evidence that its highly anticipated anime remake, The One Piece, is actively moving through production.

item.title: Netflix’s ‘LEGO One Piece’ Animated Special Arrives September 29: Story, Team, and Details
item.description: Netflix is expanding its legendary pirate franchise with a brand-new, two-part animated event.

item.title: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Brings Part-Time Jobs and Inclusive Romance to the Switch
item.description: Nintendo’s Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream officially launches on the Nintendo Switch on April 16, 2026, bringing part-time jobs, expansive Mii customization, and fully inclusive romance options to the beloved island simulator.

item.title: Silent Hill f Manga Announced: Ryukishi07 Promises a Brand New Ending
item.description: Konami is celebrating the six-month anniversary of Silent Hill f with a brand-new manga adaptation.

item.title: Kantai Collection Developer C2 Kikan Announces Ki-gō Keikaku: 3D Mecha RPG for PC and Mobile
item.description: C2 Kikan (also operating as C2Architecture), the development studio behind the industry-defining mega-hit Kantai Collection, is officially developing Ki-gō Keikaku (Plan Number Ki).

item.title: Be Forever Yamato: Rebel 3199 Film 6 Teases Massive Plot Twist: Modern Tokyo Appearance & June Release Date
item.description: The highly anticipated sixth film in the Space Battleship Yamato remake series, Aoi Meikyū (Blue Labyrinth), will officially hit Japanese theaters on June 26, 2026.

item.title: Kodansha Cancels 'Wishing You Happiness, My Fiancé' Manga After Artist Admits to Plagiarism
item.description: On March 31, Kodansha’s Monthly Shonen Magazine abruptly canceled the manga adaptation of Wishing You Happiness, My Fiancé.

item.title: One Piece Episode 1156 Preview: The Straw Hats Finally Arrive in Elbaph (Release Date & Trailer Details)
item.description: The wait is finally over. One Piece Episode 1156 officially marks the end of the anime’s unprecedented three-month hiatus, bringing the Straw Hat Pirates to the highly anticipated land of giants: Elbaph.

item.title: Ruby Hoshino Shines in Stunning New 'Oshi no Ko' x KIYOKO HATA Collaboration Visual
item.description: Strawberry Productions’ brightest star, Ruby Hoshino, has officially crossed over into the real world as the newest advertisement model for the luxury Japanese dress brand KIYOKO HATA.

item.title: The Three Kingdoms of Japan Anime: Release Date, All-Star Cast, and Trailer Details
item.description: The highly anticipated post-apocalyptic political thriller, Nihon Sangoku (The Three Kingdoms of Japan), will officially premiere worldwide on Amazon Prime Video on April 5, 2026.

item.title: Tokyo Revengers 'Three Deities Arc' Anime: Release Date, New Cast, and Trailer Breakdown
item.description: The wait is officially over for Toman fans. The highly anticipated Tokyo Revengers: Three Deities Arc (officially titled Santen Senso-hen in Japan) will begin broadcasting in October 2026.
